$comment: setspec prompt.record 1.0 -- hand-authored: PromptRecord is a plain dataclass, not a pydantic envelope payload (prompt records are pack files, never wrapped in a SchemaEnvelope). Describes the fields setspec.prompts.load_record validates; an application's pack may add further fields (task, capability, response, model_requirements, ...) that this loader carries through unread -- see prompt-management-standards.md §2.1 for the full documented shape one application (FreeWeight) actually ships.
title: prompt.record

schema_version.description: Version of this record format, independent of the prompt's own version.

prompt_id.description: Dotted, stable, unique within the pack. Never renamed -- a rename is a new prompt.

system.description: The system turn's Jinja2 template, or null when the prompt has none.

template.description: The user turn's Jinja2 template, rendered with StrictUndefined.

purpose.description: One sentence saying what this prompt is for.

variables.description: Every variable used in system or template, by name. Undeclared use fails validation; a declared-but-unused variable fails too.

change_reason.description: Mandatory on every version bump. "Improved wording" is not a reason.
